text: The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers. The base model uses d_model = 512 and 8 attention heads with key dimension 64. The feed-forward inner dimension is 2048. We used the Adam optimizer with warmup_steps = 4000 and label smoothing of 0.1. The big model reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German. We scale dot products by 1/sqrt(dk) because large values push the softmax into regions with small gradients.
Mimi operates at a frame rate of 12.5 Hz. Moshi is built on Helium, a 7B parameter text language model. Inner Monologue predicts time-aligned text tokens before audio tokens.
The routing module predicts chunk boundaries over raw bytes in a hierarchical network.
